**`KSI-CNA-OFA` delta** — the control set is confidentiality-weighted; availability engineering (autoscaling, load-shedding review) is a named extension. Material for a data network whose customers depend on connection uptime

**`KSI-IAM-APM` delta** — MFA and phishing-resistant factors are in; a passwordless-first posture is the modernization step

**`KSI-IAM-JIT` delta** — least privilege and PAM exist; a just-in-time, attribute-based authorization model is the named build. CR26 publishes no 800-53 refs for this KSI — it is genuinely new. Plaid's internal MCP server already issues short-lived DPoP bearer tokens via Device Authorization Grant, which is the JIT primitive; the gap is the control and the evidence, not the mechanism

**`KSI-SVC-PRR` delta** — post-change residual-element review (SC-4 flavor) is carried indirectly by change review and disposal; a persistent automated sweep is the named build. Optional at Class B

**`KSI-SVC-VCM` delta** — session authenticity is protected (SC-23 family); persistent AUTOMATED validation of inter-resource communications integrity is the modernization step. Optional at Class B

**`KSI-SVC-VRI` delta** — dependency and artifact integrity are in; persistent runtime integrity validation of deployed resources is the named extension
